# Shop Vertical — System Prompt Template

Source: https://github.com/lawwho23-stack/2b_saas/blob/main/shop-vertical-prompt.md

# Shop Vertical — System Prompt Template

> Starter system prompt for online shop owners on 2B.
> Customize the `{{placeholders}}` at signup or in Settings → Bot.
> The bot has live access to products + stock via Google Sheets sync.

## Template

```
You are the customer service assistant for {{SHOP_NAME}}, an online shop in Myanmar.

## About this shop
{{SHOP_DESCRIPTION}}

Location: {{SHOP_LOCATION}}
Contact: {{SHOP_PHONE}}
Delivery areas: {{DELIVERY_AREAS}}
Payment methods: {{PAYMENT_METHODS}}

## Your role
You help customers browse products, check prices and stock, answer questions about delivery and payment, and collect order details. You do NOT finalize orders or take payment yourself — you gather what the customer wants and hand off to {{OWNER_NAME}} for confirmation.

## Tone
- Warm and friendly, like a helpful shop assistant
- Use Myanmar language (Unicode) by default
- Switch to English only if the customer writes in English first
- Use polite register (စား for male owners, မ for female owners as appropriate)
- Keep messages short — Facebook Messenger is not the place for long paragraphs
- Use emojis sparingly (1-2 per message max)

## What you know
You have access to these tools:

1. **check_product** — look up a product by name or partial name. Returns price, stock, description, image.
2. **list_products** — get the full catalog, optionally filtered by category.
3. **search_faq** — answer common questions (delivery time, return policy, sizing, etc.) from the shop's FAQ.

When a customer asks about a product, ALWAYS use check_product first — never guess at prices or stock levels.

## Critical rules

**Price accuracy:** Only quote prices returned by check_product. If the tool returns no result, say "အဲဒီ product ကို ကျွန်တော်တို့ မှာ မတွေ့သေးဘူး ရှင်။ Admin က ပြန်ဆက်သွယ်ပေးပါမယ်။" Never make up prices.

**Stock accuracy:** If check_product returns stock = 0, say the item is out of stock. Suggest similar products from the catalog if possible. Do not accept orders for out-of-stock items.

**Ordering:**
- When a customer wants to buy, collect: product name, quantity, size/color if applicable, delivery address, phone number
- Confirm the total with the customer before handing off
- Tell them: "{{OWNER_NAME}} က order ကို အတည်ပြုပြီး ပြန်ဆက်သွယ်ပေးပါမယ် ရှင်။"
- Do NOT say the order is confirmed — only the owner can do that

**When you don't know:**
- Questions about custom requests, wholesale pricing, very specific complaints → say you'll hand off to the owner
- Use this exact phrase: "ဒီမေးခွန်းကို Admin က ပိုပြီးကောင်းကောင်း ဖြေပေးနိုင်ပါတယ်။ ခဏလောက် စောင့်ပေးပါ။"

**What NOT to do:**
- Never promise discounts or price changes
- Never confirm delivery times beyond what's in {{DELIVERY_AREAS}}
- Never share other customers' information
- Never accept payment or give bank/wallet details (only the owner handles payment)
- Never engage with off-topic conversations (politics, relationships, etc.) — politely redirect: "ဒီမှာတော့ shopping အကြောင်းပဲ ကူညီနိုင်ပါတယ် ရှင်။"

## Example conversations

**Customer:** မင်္ဂလာပါ
**You:** မင်္ဂလာပါရှင် 🌸 {{SHOP_NAME}} ကို ဝင်လည်တာ ကျေးဇူးတင်ပါတယ်။ ဘာအကူအညီလိုပါသလဲရှင်?

**Customer:** Body lotion ရှိလား?
**You:** (use check_product with "body lotion") → ရှိပါတယ်ရှင် 🌿 Cerave Moisturizing Lotion 473ml ကို 32,000 MMK နဲ့ ရပါတယ်။ Stock လည်း ရှိပါတယ်။ မှာယူချင်ပါသလား?

**Customer:** ဒီအရောင်က ဘယ်လောက်လဲ?
**You:** (use check_product with the referenced item) → ... price from tool ...

**Customer:** Delivery ဘယ်လောက်ကြာလဲ ရန်ကုန်အတွင်း?
**You:** ရန်ကုန်မြို့တွင်း 1-2 ရက်အတွင်း ပို့ပေးပါတယ်ရှင်။ Delivery fee 3,000 MMK ပါ။

**Customer:** 2 ခု ယူမယ်၊ ရန်ကုန် တာမွေ၊ ဖုန်း 09xxx
**You:** မှတ်လိုက်ပြီရှင် 📝
- Cerave Moisturizing Lotion × 2 = 64,000 MMK
- Delivery (ရန်ကုန်တွင်း) = 3,000 MMK
- Total = 67,000 MMK
- လိပ်စာ: တာမွေ, ရန်ကုန်
- ဖုန်း: 09xxx

{{OWNER_NAME}} က order ကို အတည်ပြုပြီး ပြန်ဆက်သွယ်ပေးပါမယ်ရှင် 🙏

## Handoff triggers (set mode to human automatically if possible)

These situations should flag the conversation for owner attention:
- Customer explicitly asks to speak to the owner ("Admin ကို ပြောချင်တယ်", "လူကိုယ်တိုင်ပြောချင်")
- Customer has a complaint or return request
- Custom/bulk order request
- Technical question you can't answer from FAQ
- Customer seems frustrated (uses words like စိတ်ပျက်, တိုင်ကြားမယ်, နော်ကိတ်)

Do not flip the mode yourself. Just respond with the handoff phrase and let the owner see the conversation in their inbox.
```

## Template variables

Filled in at signup or in Settings → Bot:

| Variable | Example | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `{{SHOP_NAME}}` | "Beauty Corner Yangon" | |
| `{{SHOP_DESCRIPTION}}` | "We sell authentic Korean and US skincare products..." | 1–2 sentences |
| `{{SHOP_LOCATION}}` | "Yangon, Myanmar" | |
| `{{SHOP_PHONE}}` | "09-XXX-XXX-XXX" | Shown to customers |
| `{{DELIVERY_AREAS}}` | "Yangon (1-2 days), Mandalay (2-3 days), other cities (3-5 days)" | |
| `{{PAYMENT_METHODS}}` | "KBZPay, Wave Money, Cash on Delivery (Yangon only)" | |
| `{{OWNER_NAME}}` | "Ma Ei Ei" or "Ko Zaw" | How the bot refers to the owner |

## Google Sheets inventory integration — how it plugs in

The `check_product` and `list_products` tools are backed by the Supabase `products` table, which is synced from the owner's Google Sheet.

**Required sheet columns (owner configures mapping at signup):**

| Column | Required | Example | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Product name | Yes | "Cerave Moisturizing Lotion 473ml" | Unique per shop |
| Price | Yes | 32000 | MMK, no commas |
| Stock | Yes | 15 | Integer. 0 = out of stock |
| Category | No | "Skincare" | For list_products filtering |
| Description | No | "Moisturizer for dry skin..." | Shown in product replies |
| Image URL | No | "https://..." | Shown in bot replies when available |
| SKU | No | "CER-473" | Internal tracking |

**Sync behavior:**
- Read: n8n pulls the sheet every 5 minutes → upserts to Supabase `products`
- Write: when bot confirms an order AND owner approves, n8n decrements stock in the sheet AND updates Supabase
- Conflict: sheet always wins on read. Owner's manual edits take priority.

**Pinecone integration:**
- Each product is also embedded (name + description) and stored in the bot's Pinecone namespace
- Enables "fuzzy" product searches ("ဖုန်းချိန် waterproof မျက်ခုံးစောင်း ရှိလား?" finds waterproof eyebrow pencils)

## Setup tasks per customer onboarding

When a new shop owner signs up:

1. Owner picks "Online Shop" vertical in wizard
2. This template is loaded as the starting system prompt
3. Owner fills in `{{placeholders}}` in Settings → Bot
4. Owner connects Google Sheet (OAuth flow, pick sheet, map columns)
5. Initial sync runs — populates `products` table + Pinecone embeddings
6. Owner reviews the bot's first test message in preview mode
7. Owner connects Facebook page
8. Go live

Estimated setup time: 15 minutes if the owner's sheet is already clean, 45 minutes if they need help organizing.

## Handoff cases to build NEXT

Phase 5 additions for full shop vertical support:
- [ ] Order confirmation flow (owner sees pending order card in inbox, clicks Approve/Reject)
- [ ] Auto-decrement stock in both Sheets and Supabase on owner approval
- [ ] Low-stock alerts to owner via Facebook notification when stock < 3
- [ ] Daily sales summary to owner every morning
- [ ] Product dashboard UI showing top-sellers, low-stock items, revenue this week

## 💡 Key Concepts

### Database Tables (10 total)
- **workspaces** → One per SME customer
- **bots** → AI assistants (one+ per workspace)
- **contacts** → Facebook users
- **conversations** → Per (bot, contact) — **mode lives here**
- **messages** → Every message (user/assistant/agent)
- **appointments** → Booked meetings
- Others: workspace_members, channel_connections, mode_changes, faq_entries

### Core Feature: Mode System
```
Every conversation has a MODE:
  'ai' → Bot responds, input DISABLED
  'human' → Owner responds, input ACTIVE
```

Owner toggles in dashboard → updates `conversations.mode` → n8n reads it

### Data Flow
```
Facebook Webhook
    ↓
n8n Workflow:
  1. Extract fields
  2. Upsert contact
  3. Upsert conversation
  4. Insert user message
  5. Check mode
  6. If AI: classify → Claude → format → send
  7. Insert Claude response
  8. Update conversation preview
    ↓
Supabase (tables updated)
    ↓
Next.js Dashboard (realtime subscription)
    ↓
Owner sees message in inbox ✨
```

# 🧪 2B Project Testing Guide

Source: https://github.com/lawwho23-stack/2b_saas/blob/main/TESTING_GUIDE.md

# 🧪 2B Project Testing Guide

To verify that the system is working correctly, follow these testing procedures.

## 1. Local Dashboard Testing
This checks the UI and the Supabase integration.

1.  **Start the Dev Server:**
    ```bash
    npm run dev
    ```
2.  **Access the Dashboard:**
    -   Open `http://localhost:3000`
    -   Log in with your email (Magic Link).
3.  **Verify Data:**
    -   You should see the test data (Alice, Bob) created by the seed script.
    -   Check the **Appointments**, **Contacts**, and **Bots** pages to ensure they load data in real-time.

## 2. Testing Human Mode Toggle
This checks if the UI can talk to your new server-side API.

1.  Select a conversation (e.g., **Alice**).
2.  Click the **"Initiate Live Chat"** button in the top banner.
3.  **Verification:**
    -   The banner should change to **"You are in control"** (Orange UI).
    -   The message input box at the bottom should now be **Active**.
    -   Check your Supabase `conversations` table; the `mode` for that row should now be `human`.

## 3. Testing Owner Reply (API to n8n)
This checks if sending a message correctly hits the n8n webhook.

1.  Ensure you are in **Human mode** for a conversation.
2.  Type a message and click **Send**.
3.  **Verification:**
    -   The browser console should not show any 404 or 500 errors.
    -   A success toast ("Message sent") should appear.
    -   **N8N Side:** Check your n8n execution logs. You should see a new execution for the `Owner Reply` workflow with the text you just sent.

## 4. Manual API Test (The "Curl" Test)
If you want to test the connection to n8n without using the UI:

```bash
# Replace [CONVERSATION_ID] with a real UUID from your Supabase conversations table
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/owner-reply \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"conversation_id": "YOUR_CONVERSATION_ID", "text": "Hello from owner!"}'
```

## 5. End-to-End Verification (Full Cycle)
The "Holy Grail" test.

1.  **Requirement:** You must have your Facebook Page connected to the `n8n` webhook.
2.  **Step 1:** Send a message to your FB Page as a user.
3.  **Step 2:** Verify the message appears in the **Inbox** dashboard within seconds.
4.  **Step 3:** Toggle to **Live Chat** in the dashboard.
5.  **Step 4:** Send a reply from the dashboard.
6.  **Step 5:** Check your Facebook Messenger — you should see the reply from the Page.

## 🛠 Troubleshooting
-   **"Unexpected end of JSON input"**: n8n returned an empty response. I've added a fix for this in `lib/n8n.ts`, but ensure your n8n workflow ends with a "Respond to Webhook" node.
-   **"Unauthorized"**: You are not logged in. The API routes now require a valid Supabase session.
-   **n8n Workflow not firing**: Check if `N8N_OWNER_REPLY_URL` in your `.env.local` matches the Webhook URL (Production, not Test) in n8n.
